decisions.reason: Imported CS and IT shorthand resolves to actual Department of Computer Science & Information Technology. Its opened official scope concerns computing/software/hardware/networks/security/AI; an illustrative transport/traffic-control application does not establish substantive Operations/OR/IE scope. No separate Ops unit inferred from methods.

sources.note: Read entire current Department of Computer Science & Information Technology page, exact unit identity, mission, all stated areas and illustrative computing applications. Hardware/software, networks, AI, security, robotics etc; generic transportation/traffic-control application example does not establish a substantive OR/IE doctoral field.

Read complete unfiltered Graduate Programs inventory A–Z, every degree label and programme entry. Computing/IT/bioinformatics/MIS offerings master’s/certificates. Actual doctoral entries DBA and DOL; unused PhD/DNP filter labels alone not award evidence. No programme pagination.

Read full displayed DOL programme overview, highlights, FAQs and host field. Exact Doctorate of Organizational Leadership, Education offering department; professional leadership/applied research/change and dissertation support, no explicit substantive Ops/IE/SCM research field. Collapsed programme-of-study/outcome detail and video not opened; no alumni career dataset changes made.

Read full displayed DBA overview, highlights, FAQs and exact Delaplaine School of Business & Communication host. Exact Doctorate of Business Administration, professional/applied leadership research; not converted into PhD. Collapsed detail and video not opened.

limitations: Actual CS/IT department identity is verified; out-of-scope describes the current opened Operations eligibility scope, not a claim about every faculty member’s possible application or historical work.
DBA remains a separate credential category. DOL is examined under its exact title and broad leadership/applied-research remit, without qualifying Ops field or credential normalization.
